title: kith-tui: revoked token shows 'JMAP startup failed'
description: Rehearsal1: revoked carol's token (chinwag token revoke 3) while she was connected. Her client kept showing 'Connected' until it next made a request (the open EventSource stream was not cut; see chinwag bead). On the next push it got 401 on Message/changes, and the status became 'Error: JMAP startup failed | bob@localhost'. No crash loop (good), but the message gives no hint that the token is invalid. The dedicated AuthError path says 'check Tailscale identity', which is wrong for a bearer-token server. Want: a 401 on any JMAP call -> 'Authentication failed (HTTP 401): token rejected'. Spec: RFC 8620 s3.1 / RFC 6750 s3.1 invalid_token. Evidence: /tmp/claude-1000/-home-mark-PROJECT-chinwag/d56f3967-d390-456c-a3d8-9501efe458da/scratchpad/rehearsal1/shots/11-carol-push-after-revoke.txt, logs/kith-carol.log (13:46:41 lines).
close_reason: 401/403 on any JMAP call or session fetch -> ClientError::AuthFailed ('token rejected; check KITH_TOKEN'); status AuthRejected is terminal: no more SSE-driven or chat-reload requests, UI stays up instead of silently exiting; main prints Display. Tests: call_jmap_401_is_token_rejected, fetch_session_401_is_token_rejected, startup_401_reports_token_rejected, no_requests_after_token_rejected
